top_offers.title: Founding Software Engineer
top_offers.why: Espa is building an AI executive assistant that acts instead of just suggesting, and this seat reports directly to the CTO owning the agentic infrastructure: architecture, data pipelines, and the reasoning/orchestration layer. That's a close echo of what Magino did founding Alaya's platform from a blank page, and the AI-native scope lines up with his current AI-augmented engineering focus, though the listing doesn't confirm remote eligibility from Geneva.

top_offers.title: CTO & Co-Founder (AI Native Proptech)
top_offers.why: Immoly is building an AI operating system for private landlords, still early enough that this is a true co-founder seat rather than an employee role. It's the kind of build-from-zero mandate that mirrors Magino's Alaya-to-Benevity arc, and Founders Factory's studio backing lowers some of the pre-seed risk, though co-founder equity means guaranteed comp is likely thin at the start.

top_offers.title: Founding Engineer (Potential CTO)
top_offers.location: New York, San Francisco or Montreal (onsite only)
top_offers.why: Clera is a well-funded healthtech startup using AI-guided coaching on biosignals to help people repair their autonomic nervous system, and the role explicitly has a path to CTO. It's a strong seniority and mission match, but it's confirmed onsite in New York, San Francisco or Montreal with no remote option, which is the main blocker for a Geneva-based candidate.

top_offers.title: Founding Engineer - Kato
top_offers.why: Kato is automating outbound loan-servicing calls with a compliance-first voice AI agent, and as first engineering hire the scope runs from real-time voice processing to infrastructure scaling, a builder's remit close to what Magino carried at Alaya. Pear VC's backing and the founding-team equity are attractive, but the near-daily SF office requirement makes relocation from Geneva a real obstacle.

top_offers.title: Founding Engineer, Trading Infrastructure
top_offers.location: New York City, remote flexibility unclear
top_offers.why: Tixlytics trades live-event ticket inventory and is hiring at Staff or Principal IC level from day one to own the pricing and execution infrastructure, which plays to Magino's distributed-systems and platform-ownership background. There's no clear AI/LLM angle to the role itself, and the listing centers on New York, so European remote status would need to be confirmed directly with the founder.
